cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Declare Allegiance
cards.instruction: Make someone choose which person, side, or claim to authority they will support.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My ribbon or Nina's for the chess-club election? One ribbon, please, where the members can see it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We're selecting a chair, not reviewing your friendships. Which candidate are you supporting?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could I wear yours today and hers tomorrow?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tomorrow is voting day. Choose that ribbon first, please. I'm asking who you'll support when it counts.
